exited_code: herdr quit right after starting (exit code {code})
killed: herdr was stopped right after starting ({signal})
not_installed: herdr isn't installed on this computer (no herdr command in PATH or the login shell)
no_answer_within: herdr started but didn't answer within {seconds} seconds
node_too_old: Persona on this computer is too old to start herdr; update it and try again
timeout: herdr is taking a long time to come up; check again in a moment
no_answer_after_start: Asked it to start, but herdr isn't answering yet
